target_customer: Procurement departments of mid and large-cap manufacturers buying parts and engineering services
problem: Procurement teams find new suppliers slowly and with poor visibility into risk. Alpas uses machine learning to search, benchmark and risk-score suppliers globally.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for enterprise procurement teams
product_category: AI supplier discovery and sourcing software

founders.name: Isabel Poppek
education: TU Munich and Max Planck Institute, mechanical engineering and finance degree
founders.background_notes: YC page says she started Alpas at 27 and has experience in startups, industry and private equity; no employers named.

founders.name: Nils Vollmer
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder with Poppek in a Forbes article as summarised from the company site; not confirmed on the YC page.

competitors.name: scoutbee
competitors.what: AI supplier discovery platform for enterprises (Artemis engine)
competitors.traction_then: about 160 staff planned to grow to 260 by 2021
competitors.funding_then: $60M Series B in Jan 2020, over $76M total

technical_complexity.rationale: Building supplier data coverage and ML matching across technical categories is data-heavy but standard ML engineering for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Value depends on supplier data coverage, which better funded rivals such as scoutbee had already built.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Coupa acquired competitor scoutbee in October 2025 per search results; Alpas remained independent.

market_need_then: Supply chain disruption in 2020 and 2021 pushed manufacturers to look for alternative suppliers; scoutbee's $60M round in January 2020 showed spending appetite.

branding.domain_note: Uses alpas.ai, currently branded Alpas AI.

rebrands.why: Site now styled Alpas AI; reason not stated.

branding.community_and_virality: No community found; press recognition includes WIRED Hottest Startups in Berlin 2022 and procurement industry awards per company site.

brand_strength.rationale: Little brand-specific coverage; niche B2B reputation among procurement buyers.

outcome_analysis: Alpas is still operating as a small Berlin team with enterprise references such as ABB, Siemens Energy and SBB listed on its site. No verified funding, exit or failure was found, so its trajectory is unclear; it is competing against the better funded scoutbee in supplier discovery.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators conflict (CB Insights $5M seed dated Jan 2024 and $7M total; Caplight $2.83M total; Origami $2.7M pre-seed Apr 2021; seed Aug 2023 per VCBacked). Only aggregators found, so no rounds recorded. Search for outcome found nothing about Alpas (results were about Aleph Alpha).
